meta.note: src/styles/tecton-tokens.css is the generated CSS export of the Tecton design system (light + dark). Every shadcn variable references a Tecton token in both modes; `light` defaults to the same token as `dark`.

card-foreground.note: Tecton has no card-specific text token; text-primary is used on every surface.

popover.note: Elevated surface for menus and popovers.

primary-foreground.note: Text on the primary action surface (Tecton switches to #ffffff on hover; Vega uses primary/80 instead).

secondary-foreground.note: Text on the secondary action surface.

muted.note: Tecton has no generic 'muted surface'; the filled-input background (also the table footer) is the closest subdued surface.

accent.note: shadcn uses accent for hover/selected rows and ghost hover; Tecton's tertiary hover surface (same as the table hover row) plays that role.

destructive.note: Error status main colour; shadcn draws destructive text on background and destructive buttons with destructive/10.

input.note: Outlined input border. Uses Tecton's hovered value as the resting one so the border does not change under the pointer; the field keeps a steadier outline at the cost of its hover affordance, and focus / invalid still recolour it.

ring.note: Keyboard focus outline. Vega renders it as ring-3 ring-ring/50; Tecton draws a solid 2px ring.

chart-1.note: Chart series colours are chosen from the 7 Tecton accents in the order used by the Cost-vs-Risk panel.

sidebar.note: Sidebar sits on the paper surface, like Tecton's side panels.

radius.note: Default Tecton corner radius (4px). Non-colour, declared in :root only.

success.note: Status success main colour: text, borders and icons (alert/badge outline and default appearance) and a solid surface with `success-foreground`.

warning.note: Status warning main colour: text, borders and icons (alert/badge outline and default appearance) and a solid surface with `warning-foreground`.

warning-foreground.note: Text on a `warning` surface: Tecton's filled-text is meant for the pale `warning-surface`, so the inverse text colour is used on the main colour.

info.note: Status info main colour: text, borders and icons (alert/badge outline and default appearance) and a solid surface with `info-foreground`.

neutral.note: Status neutral main colour: text, borders and icons (alert/badge outline and default appearance) and a solid surface with `neutral-foreground`.

neutral-foreground.note: Text on a `neutral` surface (Tecton's filled-text is meant for the `neutral-surface`).

destructive-foreground.note: Text on the filled error surface. shadcn v4 dropped this token; Tecton restores it for filled error chips/alerts.

success-surface.note: Tecton's filled success surface (alert and badge `appearance="filled"` / solid).

warning-surface.note: Tecton's filled warning surface (alert and badge `appearance="filled"` / solid).

info-surface.note: Tecton's filled info surface (alert and badge `appearance="filled"` / solid).

neutral-surface.note: Tecton's filled neutral surface (alert and badge `appearance="filled"` / solid).

destructive-surface.note: Tecton's filled error surface (alert and badge `appearance="filled"` / solid).

primary-hover.note: Button variant=default hovered / focused surface (Tecton lightens on hover).

primary-hover-foreground.note: Text on the hovered primary surface.

primary-pressed-foreground.note: Text on the pressed primary surface.

primary-active-foreground.note: Text on the activated primary surface.

secondary-hover-foreground.note: Text on the hovered secondary surface.

secondary-pressed-foreground.note: Text on the pressed secondary surface.

secondary-active-foreground.note: Text on the activated secondary surface.

ghost-hover.note: Button variant=ghost hovered / focused surface (same token as accent).

ghost-hover-foreground.note: Text on the hovered ghost surface.

ghost-pressed-foreground.note: Text on the pressed ghost surface.

ghost-active-foreground.note: Text on the activated ghost surface.

outline-border.note: Button variant=outline resting border. Tracks --input so a button flush against a field draws the same line (button group, input group, a Date button beside a Time input), and takes Tecton's hovered value as the resting one so hover does not move the border. Tecton's own resting Button border is --tecton-color-action-outlined-border-strong.

outline-hover-border.note: Button variant=outline hovered border. Equal to the resting border on purpose: hover changes the surface, not the outline.

outline-hover-foreground.note: Text on the hovered outline surface.

outline-pressed-foreground.note: Text on the pressed outline surface.

outline-active-foreground.note: Text on the activated outline surface.

avatar.note: Avatar fallback surface (Tecton's default avatar fill).

avatar-foreground.note: Initials / icon on the avatar fallback surface.

input-hover.note: Outlined input, textarea and select border while hovered.

table-header.note: Table header row surface (Tecton draws the header as a filled band).

table-active.note: Selected table row surface; the hovered row uses accent.

slider.note: Slider range, thumb and (at 60%) track: Tecton's default slider is the graphite accent, not the primary action colour.

progress.note: Linear progress indicator and (at 38%) track, same graphite accent as the slider.

light.note: The Tecton export defines both modes, so light and dark both reference the same Tecton token; tecton-tokens.css switches the value under `.dark` / `[data-theme="dark"]`. No value is derived.

palette.note: Foundational colour ramps from the Tecton Figma variables export (`foundational/color`). Each family has one 23-step contrast ramp per mode (50 … 1570; the direct steps, or `contrasts` for gray on dark). A step is the same perceived distance from the page background in both modes, so `bg-red-140` needs no `dark:` counterpart. Exposed as `--tecton-palette-<family>-<step>` in `:root` / `.dark` and as the Tailwind `--color-<family>-<step>` theme entries; Tailwind's stock palette is reset first (`--color-*: initial`) so only Tecton colours can appear. The `core`, `surface`, `transparent`, `saturations` and `washes` sub-ramps, the data-vis colormaps (`MPL`, `Colorcet`) and `custom/appColors` are not exposed.

allowNotes.palette:--tecton-color-focus-ring: The focus ring is Tecton's single `hotPink/460 (focus outline)` value, not a step of a 23-step ramp, so the palette does not expose a hot-pink family.
